name: Forex News Widget
author: fxgadgets

sections.description: Forex News Widget allows site owners to embed a real-time economic calendar filtered by impact level (High, Medium, Low) and user-selected timezone. The widget uses AJAX for dynamic loading and is optimized for mobile and desktop views.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Use the [forex_news_widget] shortcode in any post or page
sections.faq:
How do I display the widget?

Just add the shortcode [forex_news_widget] to any post, page, or widget area.
